response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN fielding AS f ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, player_count - AVG(player_count) OVER () AS above_average FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, player_count, share, above_average FROM shares WHERE above_average > 0

assumptions.assumption: NULL and blank batting-hand values are separate groups, as requested.
